title: DWARF measurement definition
description: A reusable, version-qualified observation tap independent from scenario security semantics.

schema_version.description: Version of the DWARF measurement definition contract.

description.description: What is measured, at which boundary, and what the value can legitimately establish.

output_schema.description: Repository-relative schema governing this tap's retained result.

implementation.description: Real node implementation whose signals this tap understands.

versions.description: Exact release and source revision pairs qualified for this tap.

target_modes.description: Executable modes in which this tap is valid.

compatibility.description: Exact implementation, source, and executable-mode compatibility.

collection_mode.description: Authority used to collect the value.

x-ui-option-descriptions.external: DWARF observes the real target from outside the node process.
x-ui-option-descriptions.stock-telemetry: DWARF consumes telemetry or traces already emitted by unmodified production Amaru.
x-ui-option-descriptions.compiler-coverage: A compiler-instrumented build records executed production paths; values are not performance authority.
x-ui-option-descriptions.patched-node: A minimal revision-locked source patch exposes a genuine node-internal visibility gap.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities that must be proven before the collector may start.

default_enabled.description: Whether a compatible passive tap is selected when no explicit measurement profile is supplied.

overhead_class.description: Expected observer overhead before per-build calibration.

x-ui-option-descriptions.negligible: No expected material target overhead, normally external bookkeeping.
x-ui-option-descriptions.low: Bounded passive collection expected to have small overhead.
x-ui-option-descriptions.moderate: Instrumentation or retention can measurably affect the target and requires calibration.
x-ui-option-descriptions.high: Coverage or detailed capture is intrusive and is never performance authority.

collector.description: Collector start/stop boundary and behavior when collection fails.

emitted_artifacts.description: Bounded repository-relative paths emitted inside the existing run bundle.

correlation_identifiers.description: Identifiers used to correlate samples with workloads, targets, traces, inputs, and faults.

threshold_gate.description: Whether an explicitly requested threshold may gate a run; gating is always disabled by default.
